biggest_catch: The 'up to $100' is a discount on a qualifying Home Depot purchase — savings on planned spending, not cash. The card's standard purchase APR runs roughly 18–27%+, so carrying a balance beyond any promo financing period costs far more than the discount, and the full application is a hard credit inquiry.
catches: Savings, not income: discount applies only to a qualifying Home Depot purchase — never spend extra just to chase the $100.

$0 annual fee (reported consistently by third parties; card is a no-fee store card), but the standard variable purchase APR (~17.99%–26.99% per third-party reviews of Citi terms) applies to any carried balance; promotional 6-month no-interest financing on $299+ purchases is deferred interest — if the balance isn't paid in full by the end of the period, interest is charged retroactively from the purchase date.
Full card application = hard inquiry. The page offers a prequalification check with 'no impact to credit score,' but prequalification is not approval.
Subject to credit approval; store-only card (Home Depot stores and homedepot.com only), no ongoing rewards.
Offer valid on new accounts opened by 1/27/2027; Home Depot reserves the right to change or discontinue offers.
Terms footnote '*' details were not fully fetchable — qualifying-purchase definition and exclusions may further limit the discount.
